```python
import pixeltable as px

# Get the films table
films = px.get_table('films')

# Filter rows where year > 1990 and project title and revenue columns
query = films.where(films.year > 1990).select(films.title, films.revenue)

# Materialize the results locally
results = query.collect()

# Print the results
for row in results:
    print(row)
```
